subject: Mobile Development
title: Native Apps vs. Web Apps
description: Learn Native Apps vs. Web Apps in one minute.

hook.text: Some apps you download. Others run in your browser. They look similar but work differently.

buildup.text: Native apps are installed from an app store and run directly on the operating system.

discovery.text: Web apps run inside a browser. They need no installation but can't access all phone features.

twist.text: Progressive Web Apps blur the line — they're web apps that feel almost native.

climax.text: The choice between native and web shapes cost, performance, and user experience.

punchline.text: Installed or browsed — that's the real divide.

quiz.question: What's a key difference between native and web apps?
options: Native apps are installed; web apps run in a browser
